def describe_alex_day(actions_line):
    # Split the input by commas and strip whitespace
    if not actions_line.strip():
        return "Today I did nothing."
    actions = [action.strip() for action in actions_line.split(',')]
    # Capitalize each action properly
    def capitalize_sentence(sentence):
        # Capitalize the first letter and rest lowercase, except proper nouns (simple approach)
        return sentence.capitalize()

    processed_actions = [capitalize_sentence(action) for action in actions]
    
    if len(processed_actions) == 1:
        description = f"Today I {processed_actions[0]}."
    else:
        all_but_last = ', '.join(processed_actions[:-1])
        last = processed_actions[-1]
        description = f"Today I {all_but_last}, and {last}."
    return description
